title: Reduce & Reconnect: Aerial Perspectives & Youth Eco-Action
author: Integrational e.V. Youth Media Lab
summary: Prepared and published by the German youth team during the Training Course in Brașov, Romania. Participants deployed camera drones over outdoor training grounds, raising smartphone banners to advocate for conscious resource reduction ('REDUCE') and Erasmus+ youth-led climate responsibility.
content: Through the Green Horizon international Training Course in Brașov, Romania, the German youth team deployed camera drones to capture sweeping aerial perspectives of mountain landscapes and outdoor grounds. Combining drone imagery with digital youth activism, participants showcased on-screen calls for resource reduction ('REDUCE') and civic engagement under the Erasmus+ programme.
highlights: Aerial drone perspectives captured by the German youth group in Brașov
Youth participants presenting mobile campaign slogans ('REDUCE', 'ERASMUS+')
Grassroots youth advocacy for mindful consumption and climate responsibility

title: Stop Water Contamination: Aerial Guardians of Carpathian Valleys
author: Asociația Empower Plus Media Lab
summary: Prepared and published by the Romanian youth team during the Training Course in Brașov, Romania. The team deployed camera drones above mountain parklands in Brașov, pairing sweeping canopy views with an urgent on-camera call to safeguard freshwater reserves and stop water contamination.
content: In the scenic mountain foothills around Brașov during the Training Course, Romanian youth participants worked hands-on with camera drones in open-air flight drills. Featuring direct-to-camera youth statements ('Stop water contamination!') alongside high-altitude drone passes over Carpathian canopies, the campaign urges communities to preserve mountain rivers and drinking water sources.
highlights: High-angle drone ascents over Carpathian mountain valleys and tree canopies
Hands-on drone piloting and peer-to-peer equipment handoffs in Brașov
Direct youth message urging immediate action against freshwater contamination

title: Stop Plastic Waste: Youth Recycling & Circular Action
author: IESA Youth Media Team
summary: Prepared and published by the Turkish youth team (IESA) during the Training Course in Brașov, Romania. Filmed in dynamic social reel format with aerial canopy sweeps and grassroots signs ('RECYCLE', 'STOP PLASTIC WASTE'), highlighting the daily battle against single-use plastics and mobilizing youth for circular waste management.
content: Filmed in vertical social reel format during the Training Course in Brașov, the Turkish youth group brought climate messages to life using aerial drone overflights across mountain parklands. By displaying handcrafted signs ('RECYCLE', 'STOP PLASTIC WASTE', 'REUSE') alongside environmental footage, the film sparks immediate reflection on daily consumer habits, waste sorting, and circular sustainability.
highlights: Dynamic social reel format tailored for youth-to-youth environmental outreach
Prepared and published by the Turkish youth team during the Brașov training course
